overview: Lectures and other events from the N + 1 edition
title: N + Offline

overview: In a war-torn world divided by rival states, rumors of a hidden royal treasure in the southern town of Yongxing draw together five unlikely strangers: a thief, a disgraced official, a loyal general, a tomb-guarding lady, and a struggling heir. As they search for the treasure to revive the local economy, they discover healing, purpose, and the true value of human connection.
title: A Journey to Glow
Piao Yang Guo Hai Lai Song Ni

overview: Another successful TV show on television channel STB Все буде добре! (All Bodo good) for a long time continues to delight his audience. Want to get valuable advice on the emotional issue for a long time and still be on the positive? Then transfer Everything will be fine just for you. On weekdays, Monday through Thursday at 16:00 do not miss your dose of useful and valuable guidance from leading studios and guests will all good, which undoubtedly will make your life much better and more interesting. In this program you will find plenty of practical advice in civil and family matters like raising children, cooking, looks, money, etc. And it's not just a theory with books, this is a real practical advice from the experts-studio guests on practical examples. In addition to all this, during the broadcast transmission "All Bodo good" will be involved in accidental guests from the studio audience for a good example of the question or problem.Right in the studio will be conducted experiments on random people, who want to change for the better or acquire some practical skills. Yet the project Everything will be fine is intended primarily for housewives, which has long been want to change your life for the better.
title: Все буде добре!

overview: A series of games and quiz rounds explore the people and history of Australia, exactly the way people weren't taught in school.
title: Big Backyard Quiz

overview: Australia's premier Indigenous current affairs program, Living Black provides timely, intelligent and comprehensive coverage of the issues affecting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians.
title: Living Black

overview: In her past life, Xu Wanning was betrayed by her husband. The child she raised was his mistress's, while her own son died tragically. Now reborn, she's determined to protect her son and take revenge. Amid her mission, she repeatedly crosses paths with Pei Heng, who is investigating the "Red Zhen" perfume. Soon, she realizes their connection began long before this life.
title: Eternal Joy With You

overview: The son of a convicted astronomer from the Imperial Observatory follows the clues left in his father's secret notes. Teaming up with the Ninth Princess, a skilled healer, they unravel a series of bizarre cases involving witchcraft, divine lightning, and earth-shattering sorcery. But as they peel back the layers of mystery, all signs point to a prophecy in the mysterious tome —the prophecy that says, "Two Fish Doom the Nation."
title: Heavenly Secrets Bureau

overview: Lu Huayan, the star performer of the Paramount, comes to seek revenge for her sister. She encounters Li Motong from another world called "Wujian." In his quest to find a treasure that can make "Wujian" eternal, he must kill the mortal songstress Lu Huayan. Unexpectedly, he discovers she is his lover from a past life. Thus begins a tale of intertwined love and hatred, where passion and vengeance collide.
title: Sweet Secrets

overview: Gu Liusu, the founder of a jewelry brand, is decisive and efficient at work, and just as strict and meticulous in her personal life. Yet, one unexpected night, she ends up in a mix-up after a one-night stand with "Young Master" Lu Xingchen, a man she had only met once before. To make matters worse, Lu Xingchen soon joins her company as her personal assistant. Neither of these bickering rivals could have imagined that, with time, their relationship would undergo a profound change. Lu Xingchen develops an unspoken affection for the sharp-tongued yet soft-hearted Gu Liusu, while his design talent gradually earns her critical approval. As their souls resonate with one another, they find themselves falling deeper and deeper, swept away by the quiet yet powerful emotions that build in their daily lives together.
title: Starlit Bloom

overview: On Chinese New Year's Eve, the entire household of the retired General Li is brutally slaughtered by a mysterious assailant. The youngest son, Li Jianwei, survives by a stroke of luck. Assuming a new identity, he infiltrates Ghost Valley, determined to exact revenge on those who destroyed his family. The valley's young heir, Chen Xiaoxi, is mischievous and unpredictable, yet gradually grows close to Li Jianwei, who tries every trick in the book to win his trust. Just when everything appears to be going according to plan, Li Jianwei begins to uncover disturbing secrets lurking behind the massacre. The supposed enemies are in fact the Zhongyong Army, once loyal soldiers branded as outlaws twenty years ago. The honor and reputation of the Li family may not be as spotless as believed. As loyalty and betrayal, good and evil are repeatedly turned on their heads, and the truth from two decades ago comes to light, Li Jianwei and Chen Xiaoxi must face not only their hidden pasts but also the weight of their fates. How will these two young men choose their paths when vengeance and identity collide?
title: Returned Master

overview: Modern CEO Lin Yuhao suddenly finds his consciousness transported into the tea merchant game he developed, now inhabiting the body of Wei Xiaotang, a new bride of the Li family. The only way back to his world is to complete the game's mission and win the title of "World's Best Tea." Thus, Wei Xiaotang joins forces with her husband Li Zixuan, embarking on a journey filled with witty schemes and steadfast kindness to claim the ultimate prize.
title: The Crush

overview: Jin Shisan, adopted son of the famed ginseng hunter Jin Buhuan, masters the art of harvesting the prized root. When his entire clan is slaughtered during a mountain expedition, he alone escapes, only to be captured and forced into a life of brutal servitude as a "blood slave." After enduring years of torment, he breaks free. Now, he returns to the Mount Guan Dong, setting a deadly trap to hunt down those who destroyed his family...
title: Vengeance of the Mountain God

overview: After being framed and tortured to death, Zhang Wange miraculously wakes up three years in the past. Armed with memories of her past life, she gets close to police captain Lu Ye, whose prophetic dreams offer eerie guidance, to uncover the truth. As the mist of illusions clears, Lu Ye surrenders to the devastating truth. When a bullet pierces two hearts in a dream, one remains trapped in the past while the other leaps toward the future...
title: Her Feast

overview: Drugs: A multi-billion-dollar industry that fuels crime and violence like no other substance on the planet. Turning cartel leaders into billionaires, the illegal drug industry also provides vital income to hundreds of thousands of poor workers across the globe. While some users sacrifice their lives to an addiction they can't escape, others find drugs to be their only saving grace from physical or emotional pain almost impossible to overcome. Where should the lines be drawn in this lucrative industry?
title: Drugs, Inc.

overview: From Custer's Last Stand and the Battle of Little Big Horn to the gunfight at the OK Corral and death of Jesse James, this is a history of the West like no other. Tony Robinson's Wild West uses exclusive, never-before-seen 3D stereoscopic photographs to expose the untold story of the Wild West, and reveal the true stories of the men and women who tamed the American wilderness. This three part documentary charts the 50 year period that began at the end of the American Civil War in 1865, when all the western territories in America were opened up to be exploited. Throughout the series, Tony, a huge fan of western movies, investigates the clashes between the native American tribes and pioneers, namely the famous ‘Last Stand' of General Custer at Little Big Horn. He examines the infamous western bandits, including Butch Cassidy and Jesse James, often glorified in Hollywood's latter-day spaghetti westerns, to find out if the films he grew up with relate to the reality of the Old West. Finally Tony looks at how the west was won, focusing on the pioneers that capitalised on the opportunities of the West, one of which was the renowned Buffalo Bill, the world's first global superstar.
title: Tony Robinson's Wild West
The Crime Unit of Tang Dynasty

overview: By a fateful coincidence, the waif Ruan Feifei enters the Huo family in place of a famed courtesan, assuming the identity of the wealthy heiress Huo Qingwan. For revenge, she navigates between rival factions, while becoming entangled in a love-hate relationship with the domineering marshal Huo Xiu, amidst the bitter feuds of the wealthy.
title: Lust and Lies

overview: Known for his ruthless demeanor, business tycoon Gu Yixiao has only one forbidden weakness—his secretary, Ye Xingwan. Due to a misunderstanding 15 years ago, he set up schemes to control and torment her. No longer willing to endure, the seemingly gentle Ye Xingwan turns the tables, using herself as bait to engage Gu Yixiao in a love-hate entanglement. In the end, she witnesses Gu Yixiao's repentance and the dawn of redemption, but whether her heart can truly find peace and happiness remains uncertain.
title: Half-awake

overview: Based loosely on Biolek's "Alfredissimo", Jan Böhmermann invites one celebrity guest each to his studio to cook, eat and chat together. Each guest chooses their own dish and Böhmermann adds a second one.
title: Böhmi brutzelt

overview: After a sudden fall, food blogger He Qingqing finds herself transported to a pastoral ancient world. She embarks on an inspiring journey—paying off debts through entrepreneurship, finding true love by a marriage and raising an adorable child—as she forges her own path to success. Along the way, she builds a thriving career and develops a deep, mutual affection with Fu Qinghuai. Just as her life seems complete with professional fulfillment, love, and family, she faces an impossible choice: to stay or return to her own time.
title: A Farmer's Fortune

overview: Ancient myths descend upon the world. High above, the ruined celestial court hangs suspended in the sky, where gods shuffle forward like the walking dead, numb, hollow, and lifeless. As humanity receives the "blessing" of these immortals and stands on the brink of assimilation, a defiant few always rise. They stand their ground and hold fast to the truth of who they are.
title: Beyond Immortals

overview: Cooking program with Alfred Biolek, who invites a celebrity guest to each show, talks to them and cooks.
title: alfredissimo! Kochen mit Bio

overview: After a traumatic birth leaves her in a coma, Jiang Rong wakes up as the Empress Dowager, with a newborn son. Amidst the scandal of a widow giving birth, she must conceal a deadly secret: the father's identity. To survive and uncover the truth, she navigates a dangerous game with three potential fathers, sparking a mix of romance, comedy, and unexpected revelations.
title: The Empress Dowager On A Second Spring

overview: Feng Zhilou, a mistreated illegitimate daughter, refuses to bow to fate. Despite the scorn around her, she dreams of one day fighting alongside the noble Dragon Clan. Meanwhile, Crown Prince Chu Moshang of the Dragon Clan is destined to marry the Holy Maiden in order to unite forces against the demon race. However, he rejects a union formed for duty and believing true strength should not be bound by tradition or political alliances. When these two defiant souls cross paths, fate takes an unexpected turn. Together, they break societal norms, overcome countless trials, empower each other, and ultimately change the course of destiny.
title: Dragon King's Decree

overview: Behind bars in Britain are some of the most dangerous people the country has ever known. Killers—men and women—who have killed and killed again to satisfy their own dark desires, often targeting the most vulnerable members of our society. But who is the worst of the worst? Can we create an index of evil? Criminologist, Professor David Wilson, has developed a unique system that he believes can Measure Evil, and by doing so, countdown to reveal just who is the most dangerous killer alive in Britain today only on Measuring Evil: Britain's Worst Killers.
title: Measuring Evil: Britain's Worst Killers

overview: Martha Haslbeck is a woman in her early 50s, has a 23-year-old daughter and is divorcing her husband Josef after 28 years of marriage. As a janitor she wears smock aprons and likes to wear blue when she goes out. She has the typical perm, and a beer doesn't leave her cold either. Martha Haslbeck has never left her Munich neighborhood of Haidhausen. But she is a heroine in her apartment building. She simply copes with everything. Whether it's a clogged toilet, an escaped cat or her flatmates' tarnished married life - Martha has a solution for everything.
title: Die Hausmeisterin

overview: Happy Endings with Bruno, an all-new original series starring RuPaul's Drag Race Pit Crew member and long-time masseur Bruno Alcantara. Special guests lay down on his table for a full body massage interwoven with intimate and emotional conversations which answer the question: "What does my Happy Ending look like?" Combining the soothing elements of massage ASMR with thoughtful and often vulnerable interviews, Happy Endings with Bruno offers viewers a rare glimpse into the personal journeys of its guests.
title: Happy Endings with Bruno

overview: When spoiled heiress Jian Cheng discovers her fiancé's betrayal, she breaks off the engagement in fury and enter a flash marriage with his younger uncle, Zhou Tingyan. What begins as a contract marriage born of a "life-saving debt" slowly transforms into a journey of redemption and true love, set against tangled family ties and ruthless business rivalries. Under Zhou Tingyan's protection, Jian Cheng uncovers the truth behind her high school kidnapping and grows from a reckless, headstrong girl into a composed and independent woman. For Zhou Tingyan, however, this marriage was never just about gratitude. It is the culmination of years of secret devotion and careful waiting. From a calculated bond of repayment to a genuine love story, theirs is a destined meeting of two hearts racing toward each other.
title: Long Planned Love

overview: On the massacre night of the Mid-Autumn Festival, Qin Shiyue, the sole survivor of Qin family, is taken in by Marshal Dai Shiyao. To uncover the truth behind her father's wrongful accusation, she navigates a dangerous game between two brothers—Sheng, who shifts from ruthless possession to deep love, and Dai Shiyao, whose suspicion turns to passion. As war reignites, the trio defies fate: Sheng abandons violence for love, Dai Shiyao sacrifices love for duty, and Qin Shiyue finally finds both truth and rebirth amidst the bloodshed.
title: Lock Her

overview: During the Eastern Han, Hepu's Southern Pearls were valuable, and a gambling culture around them flourished. Li Ling, known as the "Pearl Prince," is ruined by a Magistrate who rigs one of these pearl gambles. Forced to become a pawn in manipulating pearl prices, Li Ling meets a tragic end as the scapegoat. After death, he is reborn moments before his downfall, awakening the supernatural ability to see through and sense oysters. Armed with the memories of his past life, Li Ling gambles without fail, embarking on a path of revenge and a legendary quest to return the pearls as decreed by fate.
title: The Mission Is To Return The Pearls

overview: From dense rainforests to remote coastal regions, each episode offers a rare and intimate look at one animal. On the Great Barrier Reef, QLD, Dr Ann comes face-to face with a heavily pregnant bull shark, and in the Pilbara, WA, she goes fishing for deadly, mysterious sea snakes. In the steamy heart of Borneo's jungle Dr Ann looks for wild orangutans; and in the Dampier Archipelago, WA, she meets three species of turtle. In Moreton Bay, QLD, Dr Ann helps catch a dugong for an onboard health check, and along the edge of the Kinabatangan River in Borneo, she hunts for one of the weirdest mammals on the planet, the scaly, labrador-sized pangolin.
title: Dr Ann's Secret Lives

overview: Trapped in a time loop for 100,000 years, Lin Yue relived the same day endlessly, until an accidental act of saving the young saintess of the Forgetful Immortal Sect finally shattered the cycle. Now free, Lin Yue embarks on an adventure across the Hongmeng Continent, armed with eons of accumulated wisdom. But the foes he could never defeat in 100,000 years are also stirring in the shadows of this world...
title: The Time of Rebirth

overview: Follow the inspiring travels of Nela, a young adventurer who explores diverse locations around the globe, sharing her discoveries and experiences in engaging and educational reports for young viewers.
title: Nela mała reporterka

overview: The All India Bakchod Boys are back with a brand new show that's, wait for it, NOT a roast! Watch Rohan, Ashish, Tanmay and Khamba take on issues that the nation really wants to know about in On Air with AIB.
title: On Air with AIB

overview: Who are The Best People? They're the most magnetic and engaging people in the room; the ones who know how to get that extra something out of every collaboration, connection, and endeavor. These are people who are the best at what they do and know how to bring out the best in others. Now, in an era of social and political upheaval, The Best People share lessons that we can all use. Listen as Nicolle Wallace seeks varied perspectives on how to keep reaching for truth, decency, and connection.
title: The Best People with Nicolle Wallace

overview: The spin-off on Watashitachi wa Douka Shiteiru. The story will shed some light on the inner workings of Kyoko, the Landlady of Kougetsuan, and mother to Tsubaki, as she tries to take down Nao. Kyoko is a woman of the high society and the worst kind of enemy one could ever wish upon their foes. She has spent her life raising her only son, Tsubaki, to be the successor of Kougetsuan. We learn more about her dark schemes as we enter The Landlady's Room. It may even be possible to make sense of the disturbing hymns she sings and unravel the mystery behind the murder of the Landlord 15 years ago.
title: Okami no Heya

overview: In the heart of Mumbai during the 1990s, 'Arif,' a notorious and desperately romantic figure, rises to infamy as the kingpin of film piracy. As he weaves an intricate web of distribution, his audacious exploits attract the attention of law enforcement, Bollywood celebrities, and the criminal underworld, leading to a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase.
title: First Copy

overview: Till Reiners invites you to his first late-night show, which combines political satire and modern stand-up comedy.
title: Till Tonight

overview: Laugh until the tears come: In this unique comedy show, it's not who's right that counts, but who has the best sense of humor. Two teams of two comedians compete in a witty battle for the most absurd answers to crazy questions. The comedy highlight is hosted by Moritz Neumeier - known for his biting humor and spot-on punchlines. "Wrong, but funny in a different way" guarantees entertainment at the highest level.
title: falsch, aber anders lustig

overview: The Comedy Clash describes itself as "Germany's toughest stand-up competition in the world". The series shows the performances of hopeful comedy talents and follows their progress. Only the best make it to the annual final. In 2024, SWR will turn the "Comedy Clash" into an interactive live stand-up comedy event on the Twitch streaming platform. Viewers will be able to vote for their favorite comedians in seven monthly livestreams. The Twitch livestream is hosted by sports reporter and soccer commentator Robby Hunke. He is alternately supported by the streaming stars Starlet Nova, Donnie O'Sullivan, Reeze and Jasmin Gnu. They provide trenchant comedy analysis, respond to opinions and reactions from the Twitch community and give viewers the opportunity to influence the show in the stream.
title: Comedy Clash

overview: The plot tells the story of Anna, daughter of Paulo, a missionary doctor. The two live together in the north of Minas Gerais. Paulo receives a call to a dangerous mission and, unfortunately, Anna will not be able to accompany him. The father leaves his daughter at a boarding school in the interior of São Paulo, where the girl will live with very different children. Paulo promises to return on his daughter's birthday, but mysteriously, he doesn't return.
title: A Caverna Encantada

overview: A VR dating CEO who hates love meets a romance-clueless writer. As they clash between AI-driven passion and analog emotions, a sweet yet messy story of healing and unexpected connection unfolds.
title: Love Phobia

overview: New discoveries and cutting-edge research reveal the history of Rome's Colosseum and its intricate relationship with the empire that created it. Combining the latest archaeological evidence from the Colosseum itself, with clues from ancient sites in Europe and North Africa, we explore the building's extraordinary archaeological and cultural history, and its role in Rome's rise and fall.
title: Colosseum: Rise and Fall

overview: Все буде смачно! (All Bodo relish) is a show self-developed channel through which everyone can learn how to cook or improve their culinary skills. TV show goes every Saturday and Sunday at 09:00. Production project is a creative association Dmitry Kitsaya at the STB (the project "All Bodo good").
title: Все буде смачно!

overview: A chronicle of the French language, its curiosities, current events and accents.
title: Merci professeur !

overview: A journey to francophone countries around the world! In each country, we meet francophones who tell us about their culture, their way of life and what concerns them in French. The program also highlights projects that contribute to the survival of French, a living, dynamic and constantly evolving language, at the local level.
title: Destination francophonie

overview: Orphaned girl Su Jinyuan trusted the wrong person and fled her marriage, only to bring disaster upon herself. When she returned, she was horrified to find the entire Xiao family, her benefactors wiped out. To atone for her sins, her fate becomes entwined with Xie Yunyan, the Xiao family's adopted son who had taken his brother's place at the wedding. Together, they struggle to survive in desperate circumstances, break free from the shackles of the world, tear their enemies apart, and carve out a blazing, blood-stained love that defies destiny itself.
title: Aligned Reverence

overview: The Köksoylars live in an ancestral mansion as a wealthy and rooted family. With three daughters, the family is sinking and on the verge of losing everything. In a state of great panic, they contemplate how to escape the impending disaster when Tolga enters their lives like a savior. He is the heir to a wealthy and established family. If one of the daughters marries him, life will continue as it used to, affluent and secure. The idea is considered for the eldest daughter, Mercan, to marry him. However, Mercan rebels against this imposition, finding Tolga excessively arrogant and frivolous. Despite Tolga and Mercan being attracted to each other, Mercan's high pride and Tolga's spoiled attitude build thick walls between them. However, unlike Mercan, there is someone who desires him passionately- the middle daughter, Gül. Tolga shifts his focus from Mercan to Gül. As they drift towards marriage, Tolga's heart remains with Mercan. Mercan, too, has fallen in love with him. The girls' mother insists on a quick marriage because Tolga will rescue them from the financial crisis. However, Tolga is just as submerged as them and desires this marriage for his own salvation.
title: Aşk ve Gurur

overview: Based on a Canadian series, this dark comedy is the story of a doctor who is illegally helping terminally ill patients end their life, and a detective who is investigating these illegal activities.
title: Mary Kills People

overview: Suddenly red lines appear above people's head. These red lines connect people who have had sex relations. Due to this, embarrassing or secret sides of people are revealed. People call these red lines "S Line." Han Ji-Wook (Lee Soo-Hyuk) is a detective with an attractive appearance and free spirit. He chases after the truth of the S Line. Kyu-Jin (Lee Da-Hee) is a high school teacher with unique charm. Hyun-Hob (Arin) is a high school student. She has been able to see the red lines since she was born.
title: S Line

overview: Six strangers meet at a Divorce Support Group and form an alliance, pooling their various skills to become a group of audacious revengers. But the gang starts to fall apart when their pranks develop into a succession of ruthless murders.
title: The Revenge Club

overview: Due to his worsening health, Zülfikar Karslı begins to lose his former influence at the bus terminal. Meanwhile, all eyes are on his son Zafer, who is rumored to be returning soon from abroad. At the same time, Timur, a roaming repairman struggling under the weight of debts left by his father, crosses paths with this secret-laden family. Unknowingly, he steps into a fate he never imagined—as the successor to Zülfikar: Zafer Karslı. From that moment on, nothing will ever be the same for Zülfikar's children: Kudret, Derya, Cennet, Zafer, and Zafer's wife Reyhan.
title: Veliaht

overview: Bears' Lair is an exciting new series that offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to aspiring Indigenous entrepreneurs. Follow their journeys as they pitch their best ideas to four business experts and face off in a collaborative competition!
title: Bears' Lair

overview: Starting from nothing, raised in a public housing project by a mother on social assistance, Luc Poirier built an empire valued at nearly 1 billion dollars from a few bags of candy. An extraordinary life story... Imagine this rapid social ascent seen through the eyes of the person who best knows how to put words to money stories: Pierre-Yves McSween.
title: Luc le milliardaire?

overview: Based on Jorge Ibargüengoitia's novel, the series tells how the Baladro sisters built a brothel empire and became merciless killers in 1960s Mexico.
title: Las Muertas

overview: Discover flying taxis, robots for the elderly, firefighting drones, 3D holographic surgery & much more! Explore a world of technology & innovation that you never dreamed existed! Multiple Award-Winning Series TechTalk, takes you to see the hottest start-ups & upcoming entrepreneurs from across the globe. Checkout 50+ wow-factor new technologies that are transforming our planet for the better.
title: TechTalk

overview: Murder on the Doorstep: The Killer Clown tells the story of Marlene Warren, a young wife and mother who was shot in the face on the doorstep of her Florida home by a clown bearing balloons and flowers. Behind her brutal murder, which was witnessed by her 21-year-old son and his friends, lay a web of love, betrayal and deceit. Amid rumours of infidelity, her husband emerged as the prime suspect, but Michael Warren had a cast-iron alibi and was never charged. The crime remained unsolved for nearly three decades until, in a surprise twist, Michael's alleged mistress and subsequent second wife, Sheila Keen, was arrested for the crime. Although maintaining her innocence, Sheila agreed to plead guilty to second-degree murder to avoid a potential life sentence.
title: Murder on the Doorstep: The Killer Clown

overview: Hate the Player: The Ben Johnson Story is Canadian sprinter Johnson's definitely-not-biased account of the doping controversy that rocked the 1988 Olympics when he tested positive for banned steroid use, going from hero to zero in 9.79 seconds in what some called "The Dirtiest Race in History". The series takes a revealing and satirical look at the events surrounding the legendary race and the scandal behind the scandal.
title: Hate the Player: The Ben Johnson Story

overview: CNN's The Fourth in America, a must-see musical experience featuring star-studded performances and firework shows from across the country, will celebrate the 249th anniversary of the United States' independence.
title: CNN's The Fourth in America

overview: In this show, Mareike, a dentistry student from Kiel, was introduced to "Gunnar Janßen". Her task during the show was to convince her parents that she wanted to marry him. From her point of view, "Gunnar" had the same task towards his own parents. If they succeeded, they would receive a large sum of money. In reality, however, "Gunnar" was the actor Tetje Mierendorf, who had been hired by Sat.1 to make Mareike's task as difficult as possible. To do so, he ignored many taboos, such as a complete lack of table manners, rudeness and clumsiness. His family and friends were also impersonated by actors, all of whom deliberately displayed behavior that was shocking to Mareike and her family. Following the show, Mareike received a fee of 500,000 euros. "Gunnar" only explained to her and her family one minute before the arranged marriage that everything had been staged and that he did not normally behave like this. The entire show was accompanied and commented on by presenter Jessica Witte-Winter.
title: Mein großer, dicker, peinlicher Verlobter

overview: In the time of enlightenment, a battle between a sword and a gun has started. Based in the time of enlightenment of 19th-century Joseon, this drama tells the story of Joseon's last swordsman named Park Yoon Kang who grabs a gun ditching his sword and grows to become the era's hero. Park Yoon Kang is the illegitimate son of the best swordsman in Joseon. After his father got killed, he trades sword for gun as he embarks on his revenge mission.
title: Gunman in Joseon

overview: Suzuki Mitsu is a talented contract engineer working for an IT company, but it wasn't their benefits package that attracted her. She's working for the company that drove her late husband to suicide, and she won't rest until she exacts her revenge on each and every person responsible.
title: Fukushuu no Miboujin

overview: Antique shop owner Wu Xie stumbles upon a mysterious silk manuscript. His uncle, Wu Sanxing, discovers an enigmatic map hidden within it. To find the missing owner of the manuscript, Wu Sanxing forms an expedition with Wu Xie, Panzi, Zhang Qiling, and Da Kui. They venture into the location marked on the map. During their quest, Wu Xie meets Wang Pangzi, another explorer. Facing life-threatening challenges and attacks by mysterious creatures, the team relies on teamwork, wit, and courage to survive. Deep underground, they uncover a bronze fish with snake-scale patterns, a discovery that unexpectedly reveals Wu Sanxing's buried past. After a meeting with a mysterious woman named A Ning, Wu Sanxing suddenly vanishes. To uncover the truth and find his missing uncle, Wu Xie and his companions embark on a new journey...
title: Time Raiders

overview: The drama tells the story of Li Xiaoxi, a cautious and serious woman when it comes to love, who unexpectedly meets Xiaobei. Their chance encounter blossoms into a romantic relationship. Xiaobei's loyalty and unwavering support give Li Xiaoxi the strength to gradually overcome her insecurities about love. In turn, with Li Xiaoxi's companionship and acceptance, Xiaobei heals from past emotional wounds and learns to let go and cherish the present. As they navigate their relationship, facing challenges together, both grow and ultimately find a sincere and lasting love.
title: About Love

overview: Under the peaceful life of noodle shop owner Han Dong and his wife Lin Meiyue lies a turbulent past. Lin was once "Li Rongzhen" in night clubs and was blackmailed and exposed by her former "friend" Ling. Meanwhile, the secret that Han has buried for twenty years is uncovered due to a mysterious revenge plot. The relentless pressure from Han's old friend Sun Haitao plunges the couple into an invisible web of intrigue—Han's past cowardice led his high school classmate Zhao Xiaoqi into the darkest period of her life. The alliance between Lin and her former close friend Mei also reveals a shocking secret from the past that points directly at the all-powerful Sun family. The couple goes from passive defense to a desperate counterattack, joining hands to defend their family and exposing the Suns' crimes. When the dust settles, Han and Lin are imprisoned for their past helplessness and present disproportionate retaliation.
title: Inseparable

overview: Could the perfect murder be possible? A pathologist discovers a deadly bacteria called "Gift", and a fierce power struggle and mysterious serial murders take place... A fierce survival game begins!
title: Great Gift

overview: The most fragrant of all perfumes in the world is said to be made from roses that grow in a deep, treacherous mountain in the Balkans and plucked during the coldest nights. Beautiful pearls are painfully taken from clams by cracking them open. Han Seung-li finds her life spiraling out of control after her dad's death that ruins the family finances. The man she loved betrays her and she has a miscarriage not too long afterwards. After hitting rockbottom, she climbs out of her misery to take over the family business that her dad ran and marches forward to reach her dreams. Hopeful that tomorrow will be better than yesterday, she endures the pain and anguish to reach an outcome that is sweeter due to the ordeal she had to overcome to attain it.
title: Victory for Tomorrow

overview: Future magazine for children and young people that sets out in search of an answer to the question of what should be different, better, more beautiful or new in the future. In each program, presenter Felix Seibert-Daiker embarks on a monothematic journey to where the future is emerging or can already be experienced in the here and now.
title: Erde an Zukunft

overview: "I wanted to see him make this kind of face." I was a gloomy nerd in high school, and at that time I was entwined with Washizawa Natsuo – my dark past. Now, a few years later, we have reunited and Natsuo asked me out. This is my chance. We'll go out, then I'll break up with him, leaving him in tatters!
title: The Proper Way to Write Love

overview: foreign news program aired on NHK's international broadcasting service NHK World TV
title: NHK Newsline

overview: The series investigates the background to doping cases in various sports.
title: Geheimsache Doping

overview: Set against the stunning, raw backdrop of 1700s Canada, Frontier is revolving around warring factions vying for control of the fur trade in a ruthless game of wealth and power. Irish stowaway Michael Smyth has barely stepped foot into the New World when he becomes embroiled in a dangerous battle between the fearless and violent Declan Harp and the formidable Lord Benton of the Hudson's Bay Company. A dramatic story of revenge and riches, betrayal and brutality, and survival of the fittest in the James Bay fur trade, everyone is gunning to be the last man standing – from the combustible Scottish Brown Brothers, to crafty ale house owner Grace Emberly, to treacherous Captain Chesterfield, to millionaire Samuel Grant. All are willing to do whatever it takes to hold the keys to the New World.
title: Frontier

overview: Shanghai, 1933. A secret meeting of Communist underground members is raided before it even begins, leaving half of the 12 attendees arrested. Among them are a senior intelligence officer carrying vital secrets and a dangerous traitor hiding in plain sight. Chen Qianli, newly returned from the north, is sent to Shanghai to uncover the traitor and complete another top-secret mission. As old friends, former mentors, long-lost brothers and memories of a past love resurface, he must cut through layers of deception and protect the truth with unwavering faith.
title: A Panorama of Rivers and Mountains

overview: Uzaki Aiko a new 20-year-old daddy's girl works in the apparel company of her dreams. Her father, Kentaro, loves his daughter excessively to the point that he compels her to follow his house rules: 7:00pm curfew, no socialising with the opposite sex. Nevertheless, she falls in love with her colleague, played by Taguchi, and begins a mission to "graduate" from her father.
title: Hanayome to Papa

overview: Best friends Ben and Janni are so-called late bloomers and are constantly overlooked by women. Therefore, they decide they urgently need to become more "manly" – immediately. They contact school dealer Corny, who is supposed to procure them an illegal testosterone supplement from the dark web, which will become their holy grail on the path to "manhood." And indeed, overnight, they develop muscles, become more self-confident, and even manage to outdo the class bully Rick, who also has his eye on the class crush Suki.
title: Club der dinosaurier

overview: The seemingly perfect life of the self-confident, successful presenter Flo suddenly falls apart: she finds her teenage daughter Luna dead in her room - suicide. When Flo finds out about the Plan B agency, which can send its clients back in time in order to avoid mistakes and set a different course in life, she doesn't hesitate to take the second chance.
title: Reset - Wie weit willst du gehen?

overview: Love, loss, rivalry, and relationship woes. Follows the lives of the Field family in beautiful Simon's Town as they tackle trials and tribulations. Watch as secrets come to the surface and their lives intertwine with other residents of the town.
title: Summertide

overview: I'm a Celebrity, Get Me Out of Here! NOW! is a companion show to I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here! & broadcasts on ITV2 straight after the main show. It features behind-the-scenes footage of I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here! and shows the emotional responses of the contestants after they have been voted off. Series 1 to 4 was filmed completely live in the UK, series 5–8 were filmed mainly live in Australia with a live co-presenter in the UK. Since series 9, the show has been filmed completely live in Australia with occasional celebrity interviews based in London, shown through webcam.
title: I'm a Celebrity, Get Me Out of Here! NOW!
